title: Drought, Structural Breaks, and the Economics of Public Land Grazing: Evidence From the Intermountain West
title_zh: 干旱、结构性突变与公共土地放牧经济学：来自美国西部山间地区的证据
authors: Zuyi Wang, Man‐Keun Kim, Hernan A. Tejeda, Thomas R. Harris
abstract: This study investigates the decline in Bureau of Land Management (BLM) grazing allotments, authorized Animal Unit Months, across eight Intermountain states (Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, Montana, Nevada, New Mexico, Utah, Wyoming) from 1980 to 2022, examining the role of drought and structural change. Using outlier detection and structural break tests, we identify a concentrated regime shift in the early 2000s, with seven of eight states experiencing a statistically significant break between 2000 and 2003. Post‐break allotments declined by 11% regionally, ranging from 8% in New Mexico to 27% in Colorado. Outlier analysis reveals substantial heterogeneity in the nature of shocks, with Idaho and Utah experiencing permanent level shifts, Colorado a temporary change, and Wyoming multiple shocks of all types. To quantify drought impacts, we estimate a fixed effects model with a lagged dependent variable and a state‐specific structural break dummy. Results show that a one‐unit decrease in the Palmer Drought Severity Index (PDSI) reduces allotments by 0.5% immediately and by 3.6% in the long run under sustained drought. The break dummy is negative and highly significant, indicating a permanent 6.5% reduction in allotments following the early 2000s drought that is not explained by drought or market variables alone. This suggests that factors beyond drought have reduced grazing capacity. A sustained severe drought (three‐unit PDSI decrease) would permanently remove approximately 893,000 Animal Unit Months (AUMs) annually from the region, equivalent to 149,000–179,000 cow‐calf pairs and representing between $9 million and $27 million in lost forage value at private lease rates. These findings support reforms to drought relief programs to account for lagged and permanent effects, flexible permitting mechanisms for temporary drought, and long‐term adjustment assistance for permanent reductions. State‐specific heterogeneity in drought impacts implies that, while BLM already administers grazing at state and district levels, further differentiation of drought relief and permit flexibility based on state‐level vulnerabilities may improve effectiveness.
abstract_zh: 本研究调查了1980年至2022年间美国土地管理局（BLM）在八个山地州（亚利桑那州、科罗拉多州、爱达荷州、蒙大拿州、内华达州、新墨西哥州、犹他州、怀俄明州）放牧配额（授权动物单位月）的下降趋势，并考察了干旱与结构性变化的作用。通过异常值检测与结构性断点检验，我们识别出21世纪初存在集中的制度变迁：八个州中有七个在2000年至2003年间出现统计显著的断点。断点后区域放牧配额平均下降11%，各州降幅从新墨西哥州的8%到科罗拉多州的27%不等。异常值分析揭示了冲击性质的显著异质性：爱达荷州与犹他州经历永久性水平位移，科罗拉多州为暂时性变化，而怀俄明州则遭遇多种类型的多重冲击。为量化干旱影响，我们构建了包含滞后因变量与州特定结构性断点虚拟变量的固定效应模型。结果显示：帕尔默干旱指数（PDSI）每下降1个单位，放牧配额在短期内立即减少0.5%，在持续干旱条件下长期累计减少3.6%。断点虚拟变量为负且高度显著，表明21世纪初干旱后放牧配额永久性减少6.5%，这一降幅无法仅由干旱或市场变量解释，暗示干旱以外的因素削弱了放牧承载力。持续严重干旱（PDSI下降3个单位）将导致该区域每年永久性减少约89.3万动物单位月（AUMs），相当于14.9万至17.9万对母牛-牛犊组合，按私人租赁费率计算，牧草价值损失达900万至2700万美元。这些发现支持对干旱救济计划进行改革，以纳入滞后与永久性效应、建立临时干旱的灵活许可机制，并为永久性减少提供长期调整援助。干旱影响的州际异质性表明，尽管BLM已在州与地区层面实施放牧管理，但基于州级脆弱性进一步差异化干旱救济与许可灵活性，可能提升政策有效性。

title: Does data exchange platform boost green innovation?—Empirical evidence from heavily polluting enterprises with the integration of machine learning and econometric methods
title_zh: 数据交换平台是否促进了绿色创新？——基于机器学习与计量方法整合的高污染企业实证证据
authors: Yuhang Xia, Huibo Zhong, Zechen Zheng
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper investigates the impact of Data Exchange Platform (DEP) establishment on the green innovation of heavily polluting enterprises, with a focus on spatial spillover effects. Using panel data on Chinese listed firms from 2014 to 2023, we employ a hybrid framework that combines machine learning techniques, causal econometric models with instrumental variables, and spatial econometric and regression methods. The results indicate that DEP significantly promotes green innovation in host cities. The main empirically verified mechanism lies in restraining greenwashing through enhanced data transparency. However, at the spatial level, DEP shows a significant negative spatial spillover effect under the baseline spatial weight matrix, indicating a possible resource siphon effect that concentrates data and innovation resources in platform-hosting locations. Marked regional heterogeneity is observed: local effects dominate in the Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei and Pearl River Delta regions, while the Yangtze River Delta exhibits positive spillovers due to stronger regional integration. Firm-level analyses further reveal that DEP effects are strongest for firms in highly concentrated markets, small and medium-sized enterprises, and mature firms. Overall, the findings highlight data as a core production factor in green innovation and emphasize the need for spatially coordinated data governance to mitigate siphon effects and promote regional collaborative innovation. KEYWORDS: Data exchange platform green innovation spatial spillover effect XGBoost-SHAP model Geographical Gaussian Process Regression (GGPR) JEL CLASSIFICATION: Q55 R11
abstract_zh: 本文研究了数据交易平台（DEP）的建立对重污染企业绿色创新的影响，重点关注空间溢出效应。基于2014至2023年中国上市公司面板数据，我们采用融合机器学习技术、工具变量因果计量模型以及空间计量与回归方法的混合框架。结果表明，DEP显著促进了所在城市的绿色创新。实证验证的主要机制在于通过增强数据透明度抑制漂绿行为。然而，在空间层面，基准空间权重矩阵下DEP呈现显著的负向空间溢出效应，表明可能存在资源虹吸效应，即数据和创新资源向平台所在地集中。区域异质性显著：京津冀和珠三角地区以本地效应为主，而长三角地区因更强的区域一体化表现出正向溢出效应。企业层面分析进一步揭示，DEP效应在高度集中市场中的企业、中小企业以及成熟企业中最为显著。总体而言，研究结果凸显了数据作为绿色创新核心生产要素的作用，并强调需实施空间协调的数据治理以缓解虹吸效应，促进区域协同创新。关键词：数据交易平台 绿色创新 空间溢出效应 XGBoost-SHAP模型 地理高斯过程回归（GGPR） JEL分类：Q55 R11

title: Preferences for wealth accumulation and wealth inequality: Experimental evidence
title_zh: 财富积累偏好与财富不平等：实验证据
source: Journal of Economic Behavior and Organization
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-17 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: Some researchers argue that preferences for wealth accumulation contribute to the long-run stagnation of the Japanese economy. One theoretical implication of such preferences, particularly the assumption that the marginal utility of accumulated wealth has a strictly positive lower bound while that of consumption does not, is a widening of wealth inequality. We experimentally test this theoretical prediction by inducing preferences for wealth accumulation in the laboratory. We find partial support for the prediction: wealth inequality widens when initial inequality is large, but not when it is small. This occurs because high-wealth participants tend to overconsume more than low-wealth participants, partly offsetting the effect of induced preferences for wealth accumulation on inequality dynamics. Providing relative wealth-ranking information has only a limited impact on the widening of wealth inequality.
abstract_zh: 一些研究者认为，对财富积累的偏好是导致日本经济长期停滞的原因之一。此类偏好的一个理论含义——特别是假设累积财富的边际效用存在严格正下限而消费的边际效用不存在这一假设——会导致财富不平等扩大。我们通过实验室实验诱导被试产生财富积累偏好，对该理论预测进行检验。结果发现该预测得到部分支持：当初始不平等程度较高时，财富不平等会扩大；但当初始不平等程度较低时则不会。这是因为高财富参与者比低财富参与者更倾向于过度消费，这在一定程度上抵消了诱导的财富积累偏好对不平等动态的影响。提供相对财富排名信息对财富不平等扩大的影响有限。

title: Increasing Inventories: The Role of Delivery Times
title_zh: 库存增加：交货时间的作用
official: 官方日期待补 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: Inventories mitigate the risk of global sourcing. I present new evidence of the rise in U.S. manufacturing inventories after 2005, reversing a declining trend that lasted for decades. I examine this trend in a model of delivery times and inventories. The rise in global sourcing lead to longer and more volatile delivery times, which increase a firm’s exposure to risk. Thus, firms hold more inventories. I find the rise in global sourcing accounts for 86% of the rise in inventories. Further, a globalized economy that uses more foreign inputs trades-off the increase in output at the cost of increased macroeconomic volatility.
abstract_zh: 库存缓解了全球采购的风险。本文提供了2005年后美国制造业库存上升的新证据，这一趋势逆转了持续数十年的下降态势。我通过构建交货时间与库存模型对此趋势展开研究。全球采购的扩张导致交货时间延长且波动加剧，从而增加了企业面临的风险敞口。因此，企业倾向于持有更多库存。研究发现，全球采购的扩张解释了库存上升的86%。此外，使用更多外国投入品的全球化经济在提升产出的同时，也以宏观经济波动加剧为代价。

title: Risk Perceptions and Protective Behaviors at the Onset and Outset of the COVID-19 Pandemic
title_zh: COVID-19疫情初期与后期的风险感知与防护行为
authors: Joan Costa-i-Font, Melcior Rossello-Roig, Caroline Rudisil, Luca Salmasi
official: 官方在线 2026-07-13 · 来源：文章页面
abstract: We study the formation of risk perceptions— subjective probability beliefs— of three adverse events—COVID-19 contagion, influenza contagion, and food poisoning—at the onset and outset of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States, using survey data. We show that perceived risk levels for COVID-19 are similar to those for influenza but are not significantly influenced by proximity to infection and are shaped instead by an individual's gender, education, and employment status. Using an instrumental variable strategy, we assess whether these perceptions influence a number of protective behaviors. Although risk perceptions are associated with various protective behaviors, we only find a causal impact in increasing the likelihood of phone or online medical consultations by only about a percentage point
abstract_zh: 我们利用调查数据，研究了美国新冠疫情初期与暴发阶段，民众对三种不良事件——新冠病毒感染、流感感染及食物中毒——的风险感知（即主观概率信念）的形成机制。研究表明，民众对新冠病毒的风险感知水平与流感相似，但并未显著受到感染邻近性的影响，而是由个体的性别、教育程度及就业状况所塑造。通过工具变量策略，我们评估了这些风险感知是否影响多种防护行为。尽管风险感知与各类防护行为存在关联，但我们仅发现其对增加电话或在线医疗咨询概率具有因果效应，且该效应仅约一个百分点。

title: The Selective Disclosure of Evidence: An Experiment
title_zh: 证据的选择性披露：一项实验
authors: Agata Farina, Guillaume R Fréchette, Alessandro Ispano, Alessandro Lizzeri, Jacopo Perego
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-07-10 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We conduct an experimental analysis of selective disclosure in communication. In the model, an informed sender aims to influence a receiver by disclosing verifiable evidence that is selected from a larger pool of available evidence. Our experimental design leverages this model’s rich comparative statics, allowing us to systematically quantify the effects of selection relative to concealment. Our findings confirm the key qualitative predictions of the theory, suggesting that selection, rather than concealment, is often the dominant distortion in communication. We also identify deviations from the theory: Some senders are “deception averse” and overcommunicate relative to predictions; receivers respond too optimistically to both concealed and selected evidence, with errors of similar magnitude. Yet selection generates greater overall distortion in receiver behavior because it is far more prevalent than concealment.
abstract_zh: 摘要 本文对沟通中的选择性披露进行了实验分析。在模型中，知情发送者旨在通过披露从更大可用证据池中选出的可验证证据来影响接收者。我们的实验设计利用了该模型丰富的比较静态分析，从而能够系统量化选择相对于隐瞒的影响。研究结果证实了理论的关键定性预测，表明在沟通中，选择而非隐瞒往往是主要的扭曲因素。我们还发现了与理论的偏离：部分发送者存在“欺骗厌恶”倾向，其沟通程度高于理论预测；接收者对隐瞒和选择证据的反应均过于乐观，且误差幅度相似。然而，由于选择比隐瞒更为普遍，它在接收者行为中造成了更大的整体扭曲。

title: The Labor Market Value of Community College Bachelor’s Degrees: Initial Evidence from a Resume Audit Study in Early Childhood Education
title_zh: 社区大学学士学位的劳动力市场价值：基于早期儿童教育简历审计研究的初步证据
authors: Riley K. Acton, Camila Morales, Julia A. Turner, Lois Miller, Kalena Cortes
official: 官方在线 2026-07-02 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: Community colleges are more financially, academically, and geographically accessible than four-year institutions. Yet despite most community college students intending to earn a bachelor’s degree, few successfully transfer and complete one. Community College Baccalaureate (CCB) programs have emerged as an alternative pathway, allowing community colleges to confer bachelor’s degrees directly. However, little is known about how employers value these credentials in the labor market. To address this question, we conduct the first resume audit study of CCB degrees, submitting fictitious applications to real job vacancies while experimentally varying applicants’ educational credentials, degree-granting institutions, and demographic signals. In this pilot study, we focus on the early childhood education (ECE) labor market, a rapidly growing CCB field characterized by labor shortages and increasing educational requirements. We find that employers view CCB degrees similarly to both traditional bachelor’s and associate degrees, with statistically indistinguishable interview-request rates across degree types. A text analysis of employer callback messages reveals little evidence that employers communicate differently with CCB applicants, while a net-price simulation suggests that sticker-price comparisons substantially overstate the affordability advantage of CCB programs. Together, these findings provide new evidence on the labor market value and affordability of CCB degrees and inform an ongoing large-scale audit study across additional fields and labor markets.
abstract_zh: 社区学院在财务、学业和地理可及性方面均优于四年制院校。然而，尽管大多数社区学院学生有意获得学士学位，但成功转学并完成学业者寥寥无几。社区学院学士学位项目作为替代路径应运而生，允许社区学院直接授予学士学位。但鲜有研究探讨雇主在劳动力市场中对这类学历的认可程度。为解答这一问题，我们开展了首项针对社区学院学士学位的简历审计研究，通过向真实职位空缺提交虚构申请，实验性调整申请人的教育背景、学位授予机构及人口统计学信号。在本试点研究中，我们聚焦于早期儿童教育劳动力市场——该领域是社区学院学士学位快速发展的方向，具有劳动力短缺与教育要求持续提升的双重特征。研究发现，雇主对社区学院学士学位的认可度与传统学士学位及副学士学位相当，不同学位类型对应的面试邀请率在统计上无显著差异。对雇主回访信息的文本分析显示，雇主与社区学院学士学位申请者的沟通方式几乎不存在差异；而净价格模拟表明，标价比较会显著高估社区学院学士学位项目的经济可负担性。综合来看，这些发现为社区学院学士学位的劳动力市场价值与可负担性提供了新证据，并为正在开展的跨领域、跨劳动力市场的大规模审计研究奠定基础。

title: Can realized covariance measure improve VaR forecasting of China’s new energy and financial markets? ——Evidence from the A-MRS-Copula model
title_zh: 实现协方差能否改进中国新能源与金融市场的VaR预测？——来自A-MRS-Copula模型的证据
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-06-25 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: This paper proposes a new adaptive Markov regime-switching copula (A-MRS-Copula) model based on the realized covariance measures to enhance the prediction accuracy of portfolio risk of China’ s new energy and financial markets. More specifically, the model relaxes the static transition probability condition of the traditional MRS-Copula model, allowing the copula parameters to vary adaptively based on high-frequency dependence information between assets. Furthermore, given the leverage effect prevalent in financial markets, we employ realized semicovariances as proxies for intraday dependencies in our modelling process. This approach improves the ability of the model to capture asset leverage effect and accurately depict dynamic dependence. Empirical results show that the A-MRS-Copula model exhibits statistically significant improvement in forecasting portfolio risk in new energy markets and other markets. Finally, robustness tests confirm that the new model outperforms the MRS-Copula model in terms of different data, copula function settings, prediction evaluation methods and rolling window.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一种基于已实现协方差测度的新型自适应马尔可夫机制转换Copula（A-MRS-Copula）模型，旨在提升中国新能源与金融市场投资组合风险的预测精度。具体而言，该模型放宽了传统MRS-Copula模型的静态转移概率条件，允许Copula参数根据资产间高频依赖信息进行自适应调整。此外，针对金融市场普遍存在的杠杆效应，我们在建模过程中采用已实现半协方差作为日内依赖关系的代理变量，从而增强模型捕捉资产杠杆效应与准确刻画动态依赖结构的能力。实证结果表明，A-MRS-Copula模型在新能源市场与其他市场的投资组合风险预测中具有统计显著的改进效果。最后，稳健性检验证实，该新模型在不同数据、Copula函数设定、预测评估方法及滚动窗口条件下均优于MRS-Copula模型。

title: The Role of Firms and Job Mobility in the Assimilation of Immigrants: Former Soviet Union Jews in Israel 1990–2019,
title_zh: 企业与工作流动性在移民融入中的作用：1990–2019年以色列的前苏联犹太人
source: Journal of the European Economic Association
official: Crossref 元数据日期 2026-05-20 · 来源：Crossref
abstract: We study how job mobility, firms, and firm-ladder climbing can shape immigrants’ labor market success. Our context is the mass migration of former Soviet Union Jews to Israel during the 1990s. Once in Israel, these immigrants faced none of the legal barriers that are typically posed by migration regulations around the world, offering a unique backdrop to study undistorted immigrants’ job mobility and resulting unconstrained assimilation. Rich administrative data allows us to follow immigrants for up to three decades after arrival. Immigrants experienced large initial wage gaps relative to natives—57% for men and 47% for women—and 12%–20% of these gaps are explained by differential sorting across firms and differential pay-setting within firms. The wage gap closes only after 27–29 years, and much of this convergence is driven by immigrants’ differential climbing of the firm ladder: immigrants are more mobile and experience faster upward moves, even in the long term. As such, firm-to-firm mobility is a key driver of these immigrants’ long-run prosperity. Lastly, we quantify a previously undocumented job utility gap when accounting for non-wage amenities. Upon arrival, immigrants’ non-pay amenities were lower by 0.38 (men) and 0.94 (women) native standard deviations. As such, amenities exacerbate immigrant-native disparities based on pay alone.
abstract_zh: 本文研究职业流动性、企业以及企业阶梯攀升如何影响移民在劳动力市场中的成功。我们的研究背景是20世纪90年代前苏联犹太人向以色列的大规模移民。抵达以色列后，这些移民未面临全球移民法规通常设置的法律障碍，这为研究不受扭曲的移民职业流动性及其导致的无约束同化提供了独特背景。丰富的行政数据使我们能够追踪移民抵达后长达三十年的情况。移民最初面临相对于本地人的巨大工资差距——男性为57%，女性为47%——其中12%至20%的差距可由企业在不同群体间的差异化配置以及企业内部差异化薪酬设定解释。工资差距需27至29年才能弥合，而这一趋同过程很大程度上源于移民在企业阶梯上的差异化攀升：移民流动性更强，且即使在长期内也能实现更快的向上流动。因此，企业间流动性是这些移民长期经济繁荣的关键驱动力。最后，我们在考虑非工资福利后，量化了此前未被记录的职位效用差距。抵达时，移民的非薪酬福利比本地人低0.38（男性）和0.94（女性）个标准差。因此，福利因素加剧了仅基于薪酬的移民与本地人之间的差距。
